svg.title: The fine-tuning ladder: prompt engineering, then RAG, then fine-tuning — each step costs more and is less reversible
svg.desc: Three ascending steps forming a staircase. The lowest and first step is prompt engineering: cheap, fully reversible, and it got the base model about 80 percent of the way. The middle step is RAG: adds a retrieval system, and it is what installs facts. The top and last step is fine-tuning: a GPU job that is hard to reverse and locks you to open-weight models; it changes form, not facts. A vertical arrow up the left side shows cost and irreversibility rising from the bottom step to the top. A caption reads: each step fixes a different problem — try the rung below before the one above.
svg.text: The ladder: prompt engineering → RAG → fine-tuning
a GPU job · hard to reverse · locks you to open weights
adds a retrieval system — this is what installs facts
cheap · fully reversible · got the base model ~80% there
Each step fixes a different problem — try the rung below before the one above.
